data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, passengers, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and its parameters, but it adds details the true workflow doesn't show (the Flexible ticket choice, direct-only and time filters) and only partly specifies the multi-city second leg. It is still concrete enough to build an automation from.
